name: TutorSpring
shortDescription: AI learning companion grounded in approved curriculum material with honest citations.
features: Five tutor modes (Explain, Hint, Practice, Check Reasoning, Summarize)
Explicit refusal when approved material does not cover a question
Labelled demo mode with provider-agnostic live adapter
Learner flags routed to a private teacher review queue
Aggregate-only teacher summaries and learner-controlled deletion
knownLimitations: Demo mode uses prepared responses; no live LLM is called without configuration
Keyword retrieval in this MVP (embeddings are a documented future step)
